clauses.text: Unit prices are fixed as listed in Exhibit A: SM-200 at $90.00, MB-10 at $15.00, CA-5 at $20.00. Prices may only change by written amendment signed by both parties.
Freight and delivery costs are included in the unit price. The Supplier shall not invoice freight, handling, or any surcharge separately unless agreed in writing before the order is placed.
Payment terms are Net 30 from the invoice date.
